text.tspan: Falling (Pg. 11)
Shooting From Higher Ground (Pg. 11)
Range
If shooter is 6+ cm higher than target, measure range at the level of the target
(instead of measuring from shooter to target).
Cover
If shooter is 6+ cm higher than target, ignore substantial cover
(assuming that cover is not higher than chest height).

quick reference sheet 2
Interruptions (Pg. 12)
ActionSummary
If not yet activated and being shot at -> Move up to 10cm toward cover / away from the shooter.
Shooter is entitled to a single shot, even if target moves out of sight.
Modifiers: -1 for the Move, a further -1 if target gets to substantial cover.
* May also be used to avoid hand to hand fighting.
Quick Shot
Duck Back*
If not yet activated and enemy activates -> take a single Shoot against the activating enemy.
The enemy character does not have to attack the interrupting character.
If the enemy character is moving, the shot can be taken at any point during that movement.
If the enemy character is shooting:
- quickshooter shoots first if enemy is at long range
- shooting is simultaneously if enemy is at close or point blank range
If Duck Back and Quick Shot are combined (using the Joker), the shooting happens simultaneously. The quickshot target gets the -1
for the target moving, but no cover modifier (even if the quickshooter gets into substantial cover) (FAQ 1.1).
Direction and Distance
Falling Damage...
Roll a D10. Direction is the facing of the upper dice point. Distance is the number in cm.
Default: make a D20 roll on the shooting table and apply the result.
... from more than 20cm
... from a moving train / wagon
... out of a window
... from a horse / moving vehicle
Roll twice on the shooting table and apply the result.
Roll twice on the shooting table and apply the result.
Default damage. Also applies after failed mount / dismount.
Default damage. But only fall if direction points out of the window (otherwise move character
within the room).
... while jumping
Default damage (unless height > 20cm). But no nerve test required (any hit leads to a fall).
